main.description: A musical track published to an AT Protocol personal data server. References an artist record and optionally an album record.

did.description: The AT Protocol DID of the account that owns this song record.

artist.description: AT URI of the artist record associated with this song (local.open-music-streaming.artist).

album.description: AT URI of the album this song belongs to (local.open-music-streaming.album).

audio.description: The audio file. Accepts any audio/* MIME type (e.g. audio/mpeg, audio/flac, audio/wav).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created, in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format.
